# Issue #23: environment overrides are ignored

`load_config(defaults, env)` should let any key in `env` prefixed with `APP_`
override the matching lowercase key in `defaults`, with values coerced to the
type of the default (int, float, bool, str). Currently overrides are ignored.

   4|     cfg = dict(defaults)
   5|     for k, v in env.items():
   6|         if not k.startswith("APP_"):
   7|             continue
   8|         key = k[4:].lower()
   9|         if key not in cfg:
  10|             continue
  11|         default_val = cfg[key]
  12|         # Coerce v (a string) to the type of default_val
  13|         try:
  14|             if isinstance(default_val, bool):
  15|                 val = v.strip().lower()
  16|                 if val in ("1", "true", "t", "yes", "y", "on"):
  17|                     coerced = True
  18|                 elif val in ("0", "false", "f", "no", "n", "off"):
  19|                     coerced = False
  20|                 else:
  21|                     # Fallback: non-empty strings are True
  22|                     coerced = bool(val)
  23|             elif isinstance(default_val, int):
  24|                 coerced = int(v)
  25|             elif isinstance(default_val, float):
  26|                 coerced = float(v)
  27|             elif isinstance(default_val, str):
  28|                 coerced = v
  29|             else:
  30|                 # Unknown types: leave as string
  31|                 coerced = v
  32|         except Exception:
  33|             # If coercion fails, keep the original default
  34|             coerced = default_val
  35|         cfg[key] = coerced
